query:
SELECT mc.id, mc.cardNumber, mc.characterName, mc.cardType, 
  SUBSTRING(mc.imageUrl, 1, 80) as imageUrl_prefix,
  CASE WHEN mc.backImageUrl IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as has_back
FROM marvel_cards mc 
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id 
WHERE ms.slug = '2025-topps-comic-book-heroes' 
ORDER BY CAST(mc.cardNumber AS UNSIGNED) 
LIMIT 30;
